customManagers.description: The tool versions this repository hands to six others are `workflow_call` input defaults, which no manager reads on its own. Without this they are the one set of pins nothing maintains — in a repository whose entire reason to exist is that pins drift when nobody owns them.

packageRules.description: zizmor-action only accepts the versions listed in its own support/versions file, so bumping the version input without the action (or the reverse) fails at run time with `Unknown version`. Grouping them means the pair is never split across two PRs.
This repository is a CI dependency of six others. Nothing here is urgent enough to justify merging a bump unattended, and a bad one breaks every caller's lint at once.
